instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Lucy loves to travel to beautiful places and take photographs of the astounding views. She is a photographer and has gone to Switzerland. Yesterday, she took her favourite photo from the trip, of a small village on the edge of a lake.

instruction.text: Choose the sentence that describes the character best.

b.sound: An artistic woman who carries a camera wherever she goes.
An artistic woman who brings paints wherever she goes.

instruction.text: Find the details in Lucy’s picture.

atoms.a: The large white clock tower of the local church.
The snowy mountains in the background of the photo.
Two lush green trees in the foreground of the photo.

instruction.text: Choose the sentence that describes the mood best.

b.sound: A peaceful lakeside town in rural Switzerland.
A bustling city near the Swiss mountains.
